# agentic-engage

Plan and send approved engagement on social platforms.

Keywords: social,engagement,comments,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-engage".
- CLI: agentic-engage summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-engage mcp, then call summarize_text.
